user_assets_in_cooldown.meaning: the user's assets have been moved from the StakediTry vault into the iTrySilo cooldown state

user_has_full_restricted_role.meaning: the user holds FULL_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE (blacklisted) after entering cooldown

freeze_capability_effective.meaning: the blacklist freeze capability actually prevents withdrawal of the user's cooldown-state funds during the critical window
freeze_capability_effective.checkpoint: after the cross-chain unstake request is processed

claims.scope: unstakeThroughComposer cross-chain unstake of funds already in cooldown

preconditions.text: The user has entered the cooldown period, moving their assets from the StakediTry vault to the iTrySilo.; The user is blacklisted with FULL_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE after entering the cooldown period.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A user holding FULL_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE must not be able to withdraw funds, including funds already in the cooldown state.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: this loophole renders the "freeze" capability ineffective during the most critical window.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The cross-chain unstake request via unstakeThroughComposer is the checked action; the report's ambiguity about caller vs Composer processing is not resolved here.
The blacklist role is FULL_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE as stated for the user.

limitations: The freeze-capability effectiveness is represented as a single grounded Boolean because the report states the qualitative outcome without numeric operands.
Only the target impact freeze_capability_ineffective_during_critical_window is formalized; other listed impacts are out of scope for this plan.
